4_canonical_schema: research/data_contract.md defines the complete canonical metadata schema with 20+ fields distinguishing RAW/PROVISIONAL/FINAL token counts, and distinguishing REQUIRED/OPTIONAL/SOURCE_SPECIFIC fields. Every record must have: source, source_type, source_url, acquisition_date, license, record_id, content_hash. Token count status must be PROVISIONAL until PYTHIA-TOK-v0.1 exists.
5_source_mappings: research/source_schema_mapping.md documents how each source maps into the common schema: Python Docs (13 fields), Textbooks (11 fields), Stack Overflow (12 fields with pypi_overlap), PyPI (7 fields), GitHub (9 fields), The Stack (6 fields), Jupyter (5 fields), CodeSearchNet (5 fields), Reasoning (4 fields with reasoning_type constraint), Reddit (5 fields). REQUIRED fields are the same for all: source, source_type, source_url, acquisition_date, license, record_id, content_hash. SOURCE_SPECIFIC fields are recorded in quality_metadata, not in canonical fields.
6_dataset_versioning_rules: research/dataset_versioning.md formalizes PYTHIA-DATA-v0.1, v0.2, etc. When a new dataset version is created, it records: version_string, date_released, dataset_keeper, parent_version, release_notes, experiment_ids, source_snapshots (with SHA-256 checksums), validator_version, tokenizer_version, blockers_resolved, blockers_remaining. Source snapshots must have immutable SHA-256 checksums. Historical versions are preserved; never retroactively renamed. v0.1 = initial reconciliation; v0.2 = after first blocked data task completes.
7_inventory_tool_status: scripts/research/dataset_inventory.py is a read-only tool that inspects metadata/manifests/files without downloading data, modifying source data, deduplicating, rewriting manifests, or altering active workstreams. It reports: source, record count, file count, raw size, filtered size, provisional token count, final token count, license status distribution, version, manifest path, last updated. Sources not yet available are reported as NOT_AVAILABLE. Tested: all inventory checks run without error; SHA-256 basic test passes; format_inventory works.
8_readiness_check_status: scripts/research/final_corpus_readiness.py returns NOT_READY with explicit reasons. The tool checks: source manifests exist, dataset versions exist, provenance exists, license metadata exists, hashes exist where required, AST validator version recorded, tokenizer version recorded where final token counts are claimed, duplicate-policy metadata exists, train/validation/holdout policy exists, source-specific datasets are present, unresolved blockers are reported. Verdict: NOT_READY with 15+ specific reasons (missing manifests, missing dataset_versioning.md, missing provenance/license/hashes, absent source directories for SO/Jupyter/Stack/The Stack, provisional tokenizer status).
9_global_dedup_scaffold_status: scripts/processors/global_dedup.py defines interfaces and contracts only. Does NOT execute deduplication. Does NOT modify source data. Contains: normalized_hash function (deterministic, handles \r\n normalization), ProvenancePreserver class (preserves all source references), GlobalDedupInterface abstract class (not instantiated), DEDUP_EXECUTION_GUARD (explicit constraints against running on active datasets). SourcePriority protocol and DEFAULT_SOURCE_PRIORITY removed to avoid ABC instantiation issues. Intended future order: exact dedup → near dedup → provenance preservation → final corpus selection.
